snapshot.title: Implement Level 2 structured exploration variants
snapshot.description: Introduce semi-open mission variants, reduced guidance, and drag/drop style interactions while maintaining constrained content breadth and strong fallback behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Player can choose from a limited set of mission variants with checklist-style guidance.
At least one core interaction path uses drag/drop style controls where design calls for it.
Level 2 mission completion grants higher exposure payout than Level 1 and unlocks Level 3 systems.
